text_block_list.name: A Certain Horse Girl...
text_block_list.text:
In a world moving at sixty kilometers an hour,
I paint.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Horse Girl...
text_block_list.text:
Descend upon me, inspiration.
Blow everything away with pure ecstasy.
Behold.
The one and only story born from these
legs.

★—Next issue,
Kiseki sprints!
Carve a soul-stirring trail of
hoofprints!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, what an expression!
Add a white outline to make it really pop!
Nnngh,
this is the absolute best!
A plot twist like this is just...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's gonna be so pumped for
this...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —...This is my "story."

It was during the season when the leaves
began to change color.
One day amid a stretch of crisp,
clear autumn weather...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
"Lunch break is here!" "They only stocked
ten Deluxe Yakisoba Buns today!"
"That few?! We gotta hurry!!"

It was right around lunchtime,
as the girls rushed en masse toward the
school store. Suddenly,
a pair of unusually heavy footsteps echoed
out.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhh! Surge, vitality! Blaze,
hot blood—
unleash everything for the sacred cause!
Special Move... "Burning Soul"!!

She builds momentum with a bizarre battle cry.
Her form is a bit strained, but...
With spirited, powerful strides,
she accelerates step by step.

text_block_list.name: Upperclassman Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
It's useless trying to mark me,
Kiseki-san!
That yakisoba pan is mine!

However,
the other horsegirl shifts into a higher
gear as well. Apparently,
she refuses to surrender her culinary prize.
Gradually pulling level once more,
and then...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: H-Huh?! Whaaaaaaat?!

The deciding factor was the difference in
their top speeds.
In the end,
the horsegirl called Kiseki suffered defeat,
but...
choice_data_list: (...That was a really great run, t...

text_block_list.text:
She has plenty of room to grow.
I'd love to see her hone her stride and try
again—
I found myself holding the perfectly natural
expectations of an Academy trainer.
...And then came the very next day.

text_block_list.name: Running Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!
Haaaaaaaahhhhhhh!
choice_data_list: They're having a rematch already t...

text_block_list.name: Upperclassman Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Ugh, give it a rest! Just give up already!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Never!
Kiseki will never accept getting 'canceled'
on a loss!
ORA ORA ORA ORA ORA ORA ORAAAAAAAHHHH!

Still,
the difference in ability is plain as day.
No matter how indomitable her spirit,
she'll likely just taste the same defeat as
yesterday.

...Or so I thought at the time.
Assuming she was simply struggling
because she was a sore loser.
A common enough sight among Academy
horsegirls—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Giving up means it's all over!
The protagonist never gives up!!
That's what makes the story...—
so thrilling!!

text_block_list.name: Upperclassman Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
When did you—how?!
And from that position—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The inside lane is mine, Senpai!
My one and only key to turning this around
on the upcoming curve...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is to pass you... cleanly and without waste,
RAAAAAAAAAH!

She aimed for the shortest possible line.
Her opponent drifted wide and lost rhythm.
...In a split-second difference,
she completely overturned the match.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yessss! Total! Vic! To! Ry!
......Heheh...!

Goosebumps run down my spine.
That was a phenomenal,
mind-blowing comeback.
...Before I know it,
I'm applauding from afar.

Undeterred by defeat,
devising a shocking breakthrough,
and seizing victory.
Her running felt like a complete masterpiece
of a story. ...I wonder if from tomorrow on,
she'll—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Now is the time!
'Thou Shalt Not Pass Me'!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
There it is,
Kiseki's wobble run!
Weaving left and right to confuse
the horsegirls behind her, and... oh, wait,
she just got passed normally—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh,
even with a late start I've gotta go for
it!
'Full Speed Ahead'! Hang in there, meeee!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes,
Kiseki-kun's wall-kick shortcut!
............Hyaaaaah!!

And so,
every lunch break found me heading toward
the school store. Sometimes laughing,
sometimes holding my head in disbelief,
and sometimes cheering her on with all my
heart.
choice_data_list: (Now then, what kind of run will y...
(Now then, what kind of run will y...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To create a smash hit,
one must master the classics!
I can run as a 'Pacer' too, you knowww—!

Watching her time after time,
my fascination multiplied exponentially.
Finally,
my feet moved on their own to speak to her
as a trainer—
choice_data_list: Excuse me! Great job out there!
Excuse me! Great job out there!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much!
—Wait,
a-aren't you...!
The person who's always watching...!
choice_data_list: I really love the way you run!
I really love the way you run!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
————......! L-Love—...!
That means you're interested in me,
right...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to explain! I, Kiseki,
am a horsegirl who super-duper loves
manga,
and wants to run races that are just as
thrilling, dramatic,
and exciting as a manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Manga fires people up!
And why? Because it has everything!
Encounters and farewells,
victories and defeats,
discoveries and setbacks...
all the drama of conflict!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why when you read it,
you can't help but cheer them on!
'Please let their hard work pay off!'
You pray as you turn the page...
and bam! A double-page spread comeback!
It gets me so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, wanting to draw such wonderful manga
myself,
I draw every single day using the tablet I
got for my birthday!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Any and all genres!
I take the seeds of stories I find in everyday
life,
and let them sprout in my own unique way!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like the night I dashed back to grab something
I forgot.
Or the day I slid through the door just one
minute before closing.
Or the moment I triumphed in
rock-paper-scissors for extra food!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And when I pulled off a massive comeback as
the anchor in the relay race,
I totally thought:
'Don't I look super manga-like right now?!'
...You know?!
choice_data_list: Haha, I suppose you might feel tha...
Haha, I suppose you might feel tha...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —And so, Trainer-san!!

Ever since that day,
Kiseki began visiting the trainer's
office. Along the way,
dozens of manga volumes she brought over
ended up occupying the bookshelves.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's a manga I really want you to see.
Because I'm sure... you'll love it.
choice_data_list: A manga you want me to see?

text_block_list.text:
Kiseki hands over the tablet she was
holding.
Displayed on the screen is a manga...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a manga where 'the future me' is the
protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Um! Trainer-san! Racing is truly amazing!
It captivates viewers, surprises them,
and moves them to tears! It's like—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You can make manga come to life!
You can drive everyone wild,
creating legendary, flamboyant, thrilling,
and passionate manga-style races with your
very own legs!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the protagonist of that
story!
To win the race...
and shine brightly as the victor!

Swept up in her fervent energy,
I finally understand the source of her varied
and unique running styles.
In other words, she—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm always aiming to run exciting
races.
Just like how you—
felt that thrill watching me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
please come watch the 'main feature.'
............I'm running in a mock race the
day after tomorrow.

I had no reason to turn down Kiseki's
invitation.
And two days later,
I head to the track. Waiting there—

...Was a hurdle far too high for Kiseki to
easily overcome.
